task: U11 JAR v4 = U10 + cluster 1 phone (TelephonyFetcher) + cluster 3 ssl-engine (WlSSLEngine) + cluster 5 content-provider (AppContentProviders). Corrects U11c's mis-wired cluster-5 needle (was before handleBindApplication, Application not yet live -> install skipped).
supersedes: u11 277d4641 (phone), u11b d75e90c0 (phone+ssl), u11c 74434240 (phone+ssl+content, mis-wired); u11d is the current single U11 JAR version

class_delta_vs_u10.note: U10 186 -> U11d 196 (+10). U10-U11d class set diff = empty. Same classes as U11c; only the AppContentProviders wiring needle moved.

cluster_5_wiring_fix.was: U11c: install(AppBindData) needle after B8BindExtras.afterProviders -> BEFORE stock handleBindApplication -> makeApplication not run -> currentApplication() null -> install skipped (no-op).
cluster_5_wiring_fix.now: U11d: install() (no-arg; reads ActivityThread.mBoundApplication.providers + currentApplication()) needle AFTER the stock handleBindApplication reflection call returns ([B43-BIND] handleBindApplication returned OK) -> Application live.
cluster_5_wiring_fix.ordering_caveat: provider onCreate runs just AFTER Application.onCreate (both are inside the opaque handleBindApplication). Correct for Activity-launch-time queries (notepad MainActivity.onCreate); an app querying its own provider inside Application.onCreate is not covered.
